data.Name: Royal Tax Collector
data.Description: A figure in an oversized crown and a sash reading 'OFFICIAL TAX PERSON' blocks your path. They're holding a clipboard and a turnip. 'By the authority of King... uh... Reginald the Somewhat Legitimate, I demand your turnips!'
data.Outcomes: [{"probability": 0.35, "type": "player_choice", "text": "The tax collector taps their clipboard impatiently. The clipboard appears to be a cutting board with paper glued to it.", "params": {"choices": [{"name": "Pay the Turnip Tax", "risk": 0.0, "effect": {"type": "damage_player", "damage": 3, "text": "You hand over your finest imaginary turnips. They inspect each one carefully, nod approvingly, and file them in a sack labeled 'REAL TAXES.' You feel strangely poorer."}}, {"name": "Argue About Jurisdiction", "risk": 0.5, "success": {"type": "none", "text": "They pull out a map, squint at it for five minutes, then realize they're in the wrong kingdom entirely. They apologize profusely and offer you a turnip for your trouble."}, "failure": {"type": "spawn_enemy", "text": "They reveal their true form! They were actually three goblins in a trenchcoat and they are SERIOUS about turnip collection!", "params": {"deck": "beta_enemy_deck.json", "count": 1}}}]}}, {"probability": 0.30, "type": "none", "text": "The 'tax collector' suddenly looks confused, checks their notes, and says 'Wait, I'm supposed to be at the other adventure. After you point them north, they thank you and leave. The crown falls off revealing a very confused accountant.", "params": {}}, {"probability": 0.15, "type": "draw_card", "text": "The tax collector trips and their bag of 'collected taxes' spills everywhere.
